notes: Redesign the display and web app with clearer readouts, charts, navigation and responsive Brew, Shots, Machine and Settings screens.
Export shot journals as PDFs with summaries, shot logs, extraction charts, tasting notes and optional grinder photos, with export progress and result messages.
View device storage, select and review filtered shots for deletion, and reclaim freed history space.
Read release notes from the device or web update settings; stable releases also reach beta subscribers.
Show La Marzocco policy-action notices on the display and in the web app.
Improve scale battery indication, redraw the display completely after scale reconnection, and smooth live flow readouts using the configured averaging.
Restore the selected profile’s last valid shot and graph on Home after restart, and keep searching-screen menus open with Always on enabled.
